description: This file defines the Http2StructureDecoder class used for decoding fixed-size HTTP/2 structures, including methods for starting and resuming decoding operations, handling buffer management, and tracking decoding state.

classes.name: Http2StructureDecoder
classes.description: A class for decoding fixed-size HTTP/2 structures, providing start and resume methods to handle buffer decoding with internal state management.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins decoding a structure from the buffer, either directly if the buffer contains the full structure or by buffering partial data.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes decoding a structure from buffered data, completing the decoding when enough data has been accumulated.

methods.name: Start (with remaining_payload)
methods.description: Starts decoding with a variable remaining payload size, updating the size after decoding.

methods.name: Resume (with remaining_payload)
methods.description: Resumes decoding with a variable remaining payload size, completing when enough data is available.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Returns the current offset in the buffer during decoding.
